decisions.reason: The yogurt with fruit puree builds directly on existing cultured dairy knowledge and the award signals clear success, so absorptive capacity supports keeping it.
As the firm's flagship cheese, it builds on existing cheese capabilities and has high visibility, giving management confidence to interpret early exposure and keep it.
Semi-hard cheese is a core cheese type within the firm's existing know-how and shows no negative signals, so it can be managed and improved.
Spicy cheese variants extend existing cheese knowledge closely, though multiple models add some complexity, so the firm can still learn and keep it.
The mild creamy soft cheese is close to existing dairy and cheese operations and was launched with a clear brand identity, supporting learning and improvement.

Washed-rind cheese requires specialized ripening knowledge that is less close to the firm's existing capabilities, and without positive early signals or evident R&D support, absorptive capacity is too low to improve it.
